mission: Deliver one validated NexusCentral application from one source tree, with desktop and web runtime profiles, local-owned user state, routing-only shared model capacity, internal application APIs, and evidence-gated harness execution.
objective: Create one isolated candidate from the pinned live default and transfer only the 52 approved paths after sanitizing the five flagged values.

acceptedEvidence.claim: The human operator approved candidate construction but not merge, push, publication, deployment, credentials, live providers, or release.
The pinned target, immutable source hashes, mutable-control classification, and exact transfer scope passed repeated validation.

allowedReads: The exact 52-path inclusion list and five-path sanitation list
Current approved source files, including declared mutable matrix-control files
Candidate Git status, diff, and tree metadata
allowedWrites: candidate-worktree:source-candidate-r36 restricted to the approved candidate diff
exclusions: No candidate diff path outside the 52-path inclusion list
No sanitation outside the five flagged paths
No mutation of the original worktree outside matrix-control artifacts
No commit, merge, push, tag, Pages publication, deployment, credential use, live-provider use, cleanup, reset, stash, move, or overwrite
acceptanceGate: The candidate contains only approved durable changes.
oneFixPlan: Re-resolve the live target, create branch agent/source-candidate-r36 in an isolated worktree, copy the exact inclusion list, sanitize only the five flagged values, and reject any candidate diff outside that set.
validationCommand: Compare the candidate base, status, diff paths, source hashes, sanitation diff, secret scan, and original-worktree safety against the approved packet.
cancellationRule: Remove only the isolated candidate worktree and branch if target drift, source drift, scope expansion, sanitation drift, or candidate creation fails.
